display.purpose: Hero plate headline and section-opening statements only.

headline.purpose: Page-level titles: product name, catalog title.

label.purpose: Supporting facts beside or below headings; never a kicker above them.

shadows.name: plate-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive product plate hover/focus only; never at rest.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, plate reveal, toast.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action (add to quote list, send quote).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #171717; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #171717; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #171717; border: 1px solid #171717; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #171717; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Product Plate
components.description: Product card: white plate on stone field, area-dot identity, quick-add on hover.
components.html:
Sérgio J. MatosPoltronas
Poltrona Sô
components.css: .ds-plate { background: #ffffff; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; text-decoration: none; color: #171717; transition: box-shadow 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); border-radius: 0; } .ds-plate:hover { box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(23,23,23,0.35); } .ds-plate-media { aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; background: #f2f1ed; } .ds-plate-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; } .ds-plate-body { padding: 16px 18px 20px; display: grid; gap: 4px; border-top: 1px solid #f2f1ed; } .ds-plate-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #57564f; font-weight: 500; } .ds-plate-name { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-dot-casa { background: #7b4b2a; } .ds-dot-giardini { background: #2e4a37; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form input with square corners and ink focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #171717; } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid #bdb9ae; background: #ffffff; padding: 11px 12px; font-size: 0.9375rem; border-radius: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Chip (filter)
components.description: Catalog filter chip, toggled on selection.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 0.8125rem; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #dcd9d1; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #171717; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #171717; border-color: #171717; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Sticky translucent header: wordmark, nav, tools with quote-count pill badge.
components.html:
FRANCCINO
CatálogoColeçõesDesigners
components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 32px; height: 72px; padding-inline: 24px; background: rgba(242,241,237,0.94); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid #dcd9d1; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-decoration: none; color: #171717; } .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration: none; color: #57564f; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; padding-block: 6px; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: #171717; border-color: #171717; } .ds-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; } .ds-list-btn { background: none; border: 0; display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; color: #171717; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-count { min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding-inline: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #171717; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; }

narrative.overview: Franccino reads as a precise, factual showroom rather than an editorial lifestyle magazine. Every product sits on a white "plate" — a plain rectangle of paper-white floating on a warm stone ground — carrying only what a buyer or a specifying architect needs at a glance: designer, category, dimensions, finish. The system explicitly rejects the furniture category's default identity — the dark, full-bleed slider paired with a luxury serif — in favor of daylight photography, a single expanded grotesque, and square corners throughout. Nothing is decorated for its own sake: no drop shadows as ornament, no rounded cards, no italic flourishes. The one indulgence is scale: display type runs wide and large, and full-bleed photography does the emotional work, while every card, table and form stays flat and legible.
keyCharacteristics: White plates on a stone ground; paper is the surface color, stone is the field.
One expanded grotesque (Archivo) doing both display and body duty via its width axis, not a display/body font pairing.
Square corners everywhere except two small functional exceptions (badge pill, status dot).
Flat by default; a single soft ambient shadow appears only as hover feedback on interactive plates, never as a resting decoration.
Two accent hues (wood, garden) are structural area-identifiers (Casa / Giardini), not decorative color.

rules.name: The Two-Hue Rule
rules.body: Wood and garden are area identifiers first. A new surface may use garden for a genuine positive/success state, but never introduces a third saturated accent, and never uses wood for anything other than marking Casa.

rules.name: The One Face, Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Every text role is Archivo; hierarchy comes from the wdth variation axis and size, never from switching to a second family.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Metadata (.meta) sits below or beside a heading as a supporting fact line, never as an uppercase kicker above it.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: No surface carries a shadow while idle. If a new component needs depth, reach for a border or a background-color break before reaching for box-shadow.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Every card, button, input, table and panel uses border-radius: 0. Rounding is reserved for two small non-rectangular indicators (count badge, area dot).

dos: Do treat every color, font-family, spacing and radius value as a swappable custom property — the brand manual will replace some of them, not the structure.
Do use the width axis (wdth) of Archivo, not a second font family, to build hierarchy.
Do keep corners square (border-radius: 0); reserve rounding for the count badge and area dot only.
Do reuse garden as the single success/confirmed signal and wood/garden as the only area identifiers.
Do keep metadata (.meta) below or beside headings as supporting fact, never as an uppercase kicker above them.
donts: Don't add a resting shadow to a card, table row, or panel — shadow is reserved for interactive-plate hover only.
Don't introduce a third saturated accent color; wood and garden are reserved for Casa/Giardini identity.
Don't round a button, input, table, or card corner; square corners are the system's form language throughout.
Don't reintroduce the dark-slider-plus-luxury-serif pattern the direction contract explicitly rejects.
Don't promote --ink-3 into use without a real call site; it is declared but unused in the current build.
